plan.title: SHG Loan Register Report
plan.subtitle: Repayment, overdue, and purpose of loans

panels.title: Total loans
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Repayment status
panels.sql: SELECT repayment_status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Purpose of loans
panels.sql: SELECT purpose, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loans by block
panels.sql: SELECT block, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative: The SHG loan register shows that most loans are repaid regularly, with a smaller number of overdue loans. The purpose of loans varies, with agriculture and education being the most common. The number of loans by block is also provided.
